finalText:
Implemented `POST /orders/:id/apply-coupon`.

- `routes/orders.ts`: added the route, parsing only.
- `services/orderService.ts:55`: all REQ validation in the specified error order, code normalization, discount math, injected `Clock`.
- `repositories/orderRepository.ts:62`: single transaction updating the order, inserting the redemption, and bumping `used_count`.
- `app.ts`: injected `CouponRepository` into `OrderService`.
- `tests/applyCoupon.test.ts`: 13 tests covering AC-01..AC-10/14 and error codes.

`npm run build` and `npm test` both pass (18 tests).
